description:
You are a market research analyst preparing a product concept test for a new sparkling water line. You need to create standardized rating scale label sets in LimeSurvey and build a survey using them.

## Step 1: Create Label Set - '7-Point Satisfaction Scale'

Navigate to LimeSurvey's label set management and create a label set named exactly: '7-Point Satisfaction Scale'

Add 7 labels:
- Code 1: Very Dissatisfied
- Code 2: Dissatisfied
- Code 3: Somewhat Dissatisfied
- Code 4: Neutral
- Code 5: Somewhat Satisfied
- Code 6: Satisfied
- Code 7: Very Satisfied

## Step 2: Create Label Set - '5-Point Purchase Intent Scale'

Create a second label set named: '5-Point Purchase Intent Scale'

Add 5 labels:
- Code 1: Definitely Would Not Buy
- Code 2: Probably Would Not Buy
- Code 3: Might or Might Not Buy
- Code 4: Probably Would Buy
- Code 5: Definitely Would Buy

## Step 3: Create the Survey

Create a new survey with:
- Title: 'Q4 2024 Product Concept Test - Sparkling Water Line'
- Welcome message: 'Thank you for participating in this product concept evaluation. Your feedback will help shape our new sparkling water product line. This survey takes approximately 5 minutes.'
- Anonymized responses: Yes

## Step 4: Add Question Group 'Product Appeal'

Create group 'Product Appeal'. Add an Array question:
- Code: Q_APPEAL
- Text: 'Based on the product concept you just reviewed, how satisfied are you with each of the following aspects?'
- Mandatory: Yes
- Sub-questions: SQ001 'Overall appeal of the product concept', SQ002 'Uniqueness compared to existing sparkling water products', SQ003 'Relevance to your personal beverage preferences', SQ004 'Believability of the product claims', SQ005 'Clarity of the product description', SQ006 'Attractiveness of the proposed packaging design'
- Answer options (columns): Use the 7-Point Satisfaction Scale (codes 1-7, Very Dissatisfied to Very Satisfied)

## Step 5: Add Question Group 'Purchase Likelihood'

Create group 'Purchase Likelihood'. Add an Array question:
- Code: Q_PURCHASE
- Text: 'How likely would you be to purchase this sparkling water product in each of the following scenarios?'
- Mandatory: Yes
- Sub-questions: SQ001 'At the suggested retail price of $2.49 per can', SQ002 'If available at your preferred grocery store', SQ003 'If recommended by a friend or family member', SQ004 'If offered as part of a variety pack with multiple flavors'
- Answer options (columns): Use the 5-Point Purchase Intent Scale (codes 1-5, Definitely Would Not Buy to Definitely Would Buy)

## Step 6: Activate the Survey

Activate the survey so it is ready to collect responses.
